Protection against phone scams
Your bank, the police, the tax office, your insurer: none of them will ever call you to ask for a code or to approve a transaction.

resources.string: During a phone call, the STOP screen shows when you receive a code by text message, or a Sécur\'Pass request to approve a transaction (Banque Populaire, Caisse d\'Épargne, Crédit Coopératif…).
It does not see everything, nor calls over the internet (WhatsApp…): even without a STOP screen, the rule below still holds.
Your SMS app hides the text of messages in its notifications: a code received by text message is not seen. In its settings, show message previews.
A call on your landline is not seen. If someone asks you, during that call, for a code you received by text message, it is a scam: hang up.
Protection off
Protection weakened

The app can no longer save what it sees. It still protects you, but if the phone stops it during a call, it will no longer know you were on the phone. The phone may be full: free up some space, then come back here. If it has some, restart it.
If the phone prevents the STOP screen from showing, the app will not be able to warn you.
On this phone, the STOP screen cannot show by itself: the app will warn you with an alert.

The app no longer receives the notifications — the phone has probably stopped it: it does not see your bank\'s requests or the codes you receive. If this message stays, open the settings, turn the access of Call Halt Tech off, then on again.

Step %1$d of %2$d
The STOP screen only shows during a call or just after it. The app sees when a call starts and ends: not the number, nor what is said.

The phone will ask whether to allow the app “to make and manage phone calls”: that is what lets it see your calls, and hang up when you press “Hang up” on the STOP screen. It never calls anyone by itself.
If the phone no longer asks, open the settings, then “Permissions”, “Phone”, and choose “Allow”.
So that the STOP screen shows in front of your bank\'s app, at the right moment.
The phone opens its settings. If a list shows, touch “Call Halt Tech”. Turn the permission on, then come back here.

So that the phone does not put the app to sleep. A protection app is hardly ever opened, and the phone puts the apps nobody opens to sleep: asleep, it sees nothing. It uses hardly any battery: it acts only when a call or a notification comes.
The phone will ask whether the app may always run in the background, or to stop optimising its battery: accept, with “Allow” or “OK” depending on the phone.
If the phone did not ask, or if you refused: touch “Open the settings”, then the battery, and choose “Unrestricted”.
Xiaomi phones often stop apps, then keep them from starting again: the app would no longer see your bank\'s requests or the codes you receive.
The phone opens its list of the apps allowed to start by themselves (“Autostart”): turn on the switch of Call Halt Tech, then come back here.

So that the app sees when your bank asks you to approve a transaction, and when a code arrives by text message. Of each notification, it reads which app sent it and its kind; of your text-message app\'s, the last message as well, without keeping or sending it.
The phone opens its settings. If a list shows, touch “Call Halt Tech”. Turn the access on, confirm, then come back here.
Some phones prevent the STOP screen from showing. The app then warns you with a notification, which opens it. It sends no other notification.
The phone will ask whether to allow the app “to send you notifications”: touch “Allow”.
If the phone no longer asks, open the settings, and turn on the app\'s notifications.

The phone does not let the app alert you on the screen. Open the settings: turn its notifications on, and the full-screen ones; then touch “STOP screen blocked” and let it show at the top of the screen, not silently.

Do this only for Call Halt Tech, from this screen. Your bank, the police, the tax office, your insurer will never ask you to do it for another app: if you are asked to on the phone, hang up.
Android blocks this access for apps installed from a file. You only unblock it once.

1. Touch “Open the settings” and try to turn the access on for Call Halt Tech. The phone refuses: close its message. That refusal is needed: it makes the next step appear.
2. Touch “Open the app info”, below: the page of Call Halt Tech opens.
3. Touch the three dots at the top right, then “Allow restricted settings”. If the phone asks for the code that unlocks it, type it yourself, without telling anyone.
4. Come back here, and touch “Open the settings” again.

If the STOP screen appears during a call or just after it, or if \"Continue\" is chosen despite it, a text goes to the person you choose. It says what happened, never your codes or what your messages say.
The text goes from your number, like any text, and shows in your conversation with that person. As soon as you choose them, a first text tells them they will be alerted.
